ellen_cs: Ok team — greenfield (acct GF-314) onboarding: they want Dedicated pool live + autoscale by EOW. Proposing initial quota: 24 GPU slots (8x p3.2xlarge equiv) with burst headroom to 36 for first 48h. Thoughts?
priya_se: 24 sounds reasonable for their traffic profile. recommend: target batch_size=8, kv_cache=enabled, token_limit=2048. will add quantized model variant to the rollout to save cost.
jorge_oncall: +1. Can we set autoscale policy to 'aggressive' for first 24h (scale step 4 slots / 60s) then relax to normal (2 slots / 5m)? Also need runbook link and escalation path.
ellen_cs: yes — propose aggressive then ramp down. runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/dedicated-bringup (see section "priming & burst policies"). i'll paste the quick loadtest command below.
ellen_cs: ```
# schedule from your laptop to hit their sandbox pool
loadtest --concurrency 48 --duration 30m --model redwood-alpha-quant --rate 120/s --endpoint https://dedicated.greenfield.redwood/api/generate
```
liam_prod: Quick Q: renewal flag — GF is on a 12mo reserved trial. if we see >20% latency regressions or >2% error rate during priming we should pause the trial and issue remediation plan. Need enablement session scheduled for their infra/app team.
priya_se: i'll own enablement — can run a 60m workshop Tuesday 10am PT. will cover warmup, request shaping, and SDK best practices.
capacity-bot: Pool allocation complete: pool-id gf-reserved-1815 allocated 24 -> 36 burst. ETA for eviction window: 7 days. (trace: #alloc-9f7b)
jorge_oncall: please add synthetic SLO monitors: p50 < 220ms, p95 < 450ms, error_rate < 1.5% for the dedicated pool. i'll configure alerts to page on breach.
ellen_cs: Action items: (1) priya -> run enablement Tue 10am PT; (2) priy a/priya_se -> push quantized variant + batch config; (3) jorge -> set autoscale + SLO alerts; (4) liam -> prepare renewal-risk playbook if thresholds breach; (5) ops -> start loadtest Tue 11am PT (after enablement). i'll update GF-314 ticket with these. :thumbsup:
liam_prod: thanks all. i'll prep the renewal play and customer comms template.
priya_se: copying the snippet i'll use for warmup priming in the ticket: ```
for i in {1..8}; do curl -s -X POST https://dedicated.greenfield.redwood/api/generate -d '{"prompt":"warmup","max_tokens":16}' & done
```
ellen_cs: perfect. will close this thread after runbook + ticket updated. ping me if anything changes. :raised_hands:
